spans.s:
प्र-चिकीर्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, intending or purposing
to recompense, wishing to requite (= प्रति-चि-
कीर्षु).
प्रचिकीर्षु प्र-चिकीर्षु. See p. 603, col. 2.

प्रचकित प्र-चकित, अस्, आ, अम्, trembling,
shuddering, terrified, startled.

प्रचक्र प्र-चक्र, अम्, n. an army in motion;
a foraging army.

प्रचक्ष् प्र-चक्ष्, cl. 2. A. -चष्टे, -चष्-
टुम्, to tell, relate, recount, inform; to suppose,
consider as, regard as, deem; to call, name: Caus.
-चक्षयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to irradiate, illumine.
प्र-चक्षण, see Gaṇa Gotrādi to Pāṇ.

प्र-चक्षस्, आस्, m. the regent of the planet
Jupiter, Bṛhas-pati.

प्रचण्ड प्र-चण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, excessively
violent, vehement, impetuous, passionate, furious,
enraged, wrathful; very hot or burning; intolerable,
insupportable; terrible, terrific; bold, confident, pre-
suming; (अस्), m. a species of oleander with white
flowers; N. of a Dānava; of a goblin; of a son of
Vatsa-prī and Su-nanda; (आ), f. a species of Dūrvā
with white flowers; a form or Śakti of Durgā.
—प्रचण्ड-घोण, अस्, आ, अम्, large-nosed, hav-
ing a large or prominent nose.
—प्रचण्ड-ता, f.
violence, vehemence; boldness.
—प्रचण्ड-पाण्-
डव, अम्, n. ‘the wrathful sons of Pāṇḍu,’ N. of
a comedy by Rāja-śekhara (= बाल-भारत).
—प्रचण्ड-मूर्ति, इस्, f. ‘oleander-formed,’ a
species of tree, Tapia Cratæva.
—प्रचण्ड-वर्-
मन्, आ, m., N. of a prince (a younger brother of
Caṇḍa-varman).
—प्रचण्ड-सूर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, hav-
ing a hot or burning sun
—प्रचण्ड-सेन, अस्, m.
‘having a formidable army,’ N. of a prince of Tāmra-
liptikā.
—प्रचण्डातप (˚ड-आत्˚), अस्, m. fierce
or stifling heat.

प्रचत् प्र-चत्, Caus. A. -चातयते, -यितुम्,
Ved. to drive away, frighten or scare away; (ac-
cording to Sāy.) to destroy utterly, consume.
प्र-चता, ind., Ved. secretly, in secret, clandestinely.
प्रचय प्र-चय, &c. See under प्र-चि, col. 3.

प्र-चय, अस्, m. collecting, gathering (as fruit
or flowers, but especially by means of a stick or
other implement); a heap, quantity, number; slight
union or aggregation; the neutral accentless tone
(also called एक-श्रुति); the common increase or
difference of the terms in a progression (in algebra).
—प्रचय-स्वर, अस्, m. (in Ved. gram.) ‘the
most usual tone,’ the accentless or neutral tone
neither raised nor depressed (= प्र-चय, प्र-चित,
प्रचित-स्वर).
प्रचाय प्र-चाय. See under प्र-चि below.

प्र-चाय, अस्, m. or प्र-चायिका, f. gathering
(with the hand), plucking, collecting.

प्रचर् प्र-चर्, cl. 1. P. (ep. also A.) -च-
रति (-ते), -चरितुम्, to come forth, issue forth,
appear; to proceed towards, arrive at, reach, attain;
to visit; to roam, wander; to circulate, become
current (as a story); to undertake, perform, discharge
(especially sacred functions, with inst. of the object
or of the means employed); to proceed, behave,
act in a particular manner (e. g. भृत्य-वत् प्र-
चर्, to act like a servant); to treat (e. g. मिथ्या
प्र-चर्, to treat wrongly or unskilfully); to be
busied about, to be occupied or engaged in (with loc.);
to do, perform, fulfil, practise; to succeed, thrive,
prosper: Caus. -चारयति, -यितुम्, to allow to roam,
cause to graze, turn out to graze; to make public.

प्र-चर, अस्, m. a road, way, path; usage, cus-
tom, currency; going well or widely; N. of a people
(in this sense also read प्रच्चर, प्रस्तर).

प्र-चार, अस्, m. coming forth, going forth, ap-
pearing, becoming manifest, showing one's self;
being in actual use, currency; appearance, manifesta-
tion; proceeding, taking place, being used or ap-
plied; going, wandering; conduct, behaviour; pre-
valence, currency, custom, usage; a play-ground, place
of exercise; pasture ground, pasture, pasturage.

प्राचार प्राचार (प्र-आच्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, con-
trary to or deviating from ordinary institutions and
observances (?); (अस्), m. a particular insect.

प्र-चरण, अम्, n. going, proceeding; circu-
lating, being current; proceeding with, beginning,
undertaking; employing, using; (ई), f., Ved., scil.
स्रुच्, a wooden ladle employed for want of a better
at a sacrifice.

प्र-चरणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be used, being
in actual use.

प्र-चरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going forth, going well
or quickly, going widely, being current, circulating.

प्र-चरित, अस्, आ, अम्, gone, going; pursued,
practised (as a profession).

प्र-चारित, अस्, आ, अम्, allowed to wander or
roam about; made public or manifest.

प्र-चरितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be proceeded with
or undertaken, to be performed.

प्र-चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, coming forth, appearing,
manifesting one's self; going about, wandering; pro-
ceeding with, behaving.

प्रचल् प्र-चल्, cl. 1. P. -चलति, -चलितुम्,
to be set in motion, shake, quake, totter, tremble;
to move forth, move on, advance; to start up, spring
up; to start, set out, set forth, depart; to become
troubled or confused, to be perplexed or bewildered,
to be excited; to swerve, deviate from (with abl.):
[]
Caus. -चलयति, -यितुम्, to set in motion, move,
jog, wag; -चालयति, -यितुम्, to cause to shake or
tremble; to stir up, stir round.

प्र-चल, अस्, आ, अम्, being in motion, trembling,
shaking; going well or widely; current, circulating,
customary.

प्रचाल प्र-चाल, अस्, m. the neck of the
Vīṇā or Indian lute; (a wrong reading for प्र-बाल.)

प्र-चलक, अस्, m. a venomous species of reptile;
[cf. प्र-चलाक.]

प्र-चालक, अस्, इका, अम्, (at the end of a comp.)
causing to tremble, trembling with.
प्रचलकिन्. See प्रचलाकिन् below.

प्रचलाकिन्, ई, m. a peacock; a snake; (also
spelt प्रचलकिन्.)

प्र-चलत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, moving, trembling, shak-
ing; going or proceeding far; circulating, being cur-
rent or customary; prevailing, being recognised (as
authority or law).

प्र-चलन, अम्, n. trembling, shaking, rocking,
swaying, tottering; retiring, retreating, fleeing, flight;
moving to and fro; going well or widely; circu-
lating, being current or customary.

प्र-चालन, अम्, n. stirring, stir; making a
noise (?).

प्रचलाय, Nom. P. प्रचलायति, -यितुम्, to
move to and fro, to nod the head.

प्र-चलित, अस्, आ, अम्, set in motion, moved,
shaken; swinging to and fro; rolling (as the eye);
gone far or wide, wandering, roving; having set out
or moved forwards, having proceeded; current, cus-
tomary, circulating; prevailing, recognised, received
(as authority or law).

प्रचषाल प्र-चषाल, अम्, n. a particular
ornament on a sacrificial post.

प्रचि प्र-चि, cl. 5. P. A. -चिनोति, -चिनुते,
-चेतुम्, to collect, gather, pluck; to cut down, cut
to pieces; to increase, augment, enhance: Pass.
-चीयते, to be gathered or collected; to grow.
प्र-चयन, अम्, n. gathering, collecting.

प्र-चित, अस्, आ, अम्, gathered, collected, plucked;
accumulated, amassed; covered, filled; accentless or
An-udātta, = प्र-चय; (अस्), m. a kind of Daṇḍaka
metre (also called प्रचितक).
—प्रचित-स्वर =
प्रचय-स्वर, q. v.

प्र-चिन्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, gathering, collecting,
plucking; (अन्), m., N. of a son of Janam-ejaya.

प्राचिन्वत् प्राचिन्वत्, अन्, m., N. of a son
of Janam-ejaya (= प्र-चिन्वत्).

प्रचित् प्र-चित्, cl. 3. P. A. -चिकेत्ति, -चि-
कित्ते, -चेतितुम्, Ved. to know; to make known,
announce, proclaim; to become visible or percep-
tible, appear: Caus. P. -चेतयति, -यितुम्, to make
known, cause to appear; to observe, notice, remark,
perceive; (A.) to appear: Desid. -चिकित्सति, to show,
point out.

प्र-चिकित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. familiar or conver-
sant with.

प्र-चेतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, attentive, observant, con-
versant or familiar with, clever, wise, intelligent
(mostly Ved. as an epithet of the gods and especially
of Agni and the Ādityas); happy, delighted; (आस्),
m. an epithet of Varuṇa regent of the waters; N. of
a Prajā-pati (an ancient sage and law-giver, Manu
1. 35); of a prince (son of Duduha); of a son of
Dur-yāman; of a son of Dur-mada; (असस्), m. pl.
the ten sons of Prācīna-barhis by a daughter of
Varuṇa (they are the progenitors of Dakṣa; in this
sense also written प्र-चेतस).
प्रचेतस् प्र-चेतस्. See above.

प्राचेतस् प्राचेतस्, असस्, m. pl. an epithet
of the ten sons of Prācīna-barhis (= प्र-चेतस्).

प्र-चेतुन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. affording a wide
view or prospect; (Sāy.) = प्रकर्षेण फल-
भोग-ज्ञापक, notifying in a high degree the
experience of results (of actions).

प्रचिन्त् प्र-चिन्त्, cl. 10. P. -चिन्तयति, -यि-
तुम्, to think upon, reflect, muse, meditate, con-
sider; to find out, devise, contrive.

1. प्र-चिन्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be reflected or medi-
tated upon.
2. प्र-चिन्त्य, ind. having reflected or considered.

प्रचीबल प्रचीबल, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?),
a species of plant.

प्रचीर प्र-चीर, अस्, m., N. of a son of
Vatsa-prī and Su-nandā.

प्राचीर प्राचीर, अम्, n. an enclosure, hedge,
fence, wall; [cf. क्षौणी-प्˚, मही-प्˚.]

प्रचुद् प्र-चुद्, cl. 1. P. A. -चोदति, -ते,
-चोदितुम्, to drive on, drive, impel (Ved.): Caus.
-चोदयति, -यितुम्, to set in rapid motion, push on,
drive on, drive, impel, urge on; to excite, animate,
inspire, inflame; to request, ask, solicit, importune;
to decree, determine, settle; to announce, make
known, proclaim; to hasten, make haste.
प्र-चोद, अस्, m. instigating, inciting, exciting.
प्रचोद प्र-चोद, &c. See प्र-चुद्, col. 1.

प्र-चोदक, अस्, इका, अम्, instigating; (इका), f.
‘inflamer,’ epithet of the four daughters of Ni-yojikā
daughter of the demon Duḥ-saha.

प्र-चोदन, अम्, n. instigating, inciting, excit-
ing; directing, enjoining, prescribing, ordering, an
order; a rule or law; saying; sending; (ई), f. the
plant Solanum Jacquini.

प्र-चोदित, अस्, आ, अम्, driven on, impelled,
instigated, incited; decreed, determined; announced,
proclaimed; prescribed, commanded, directed (Manu
); sent.

प्र-चोदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, driving forward, urging;
(इनी), f. prickly nightshade, Solanum Jacquini.

प्रचुर प्रचुर, अस्, आ, अम्, much, many,
abundant (opposed to अल्प); plenteous, plentiful,
frequent; abounding in, filled with, replete with (in
comp., e. g. वृक्ष-प्˚, abounding in trees).
—प्र-
चुर-ता, f. or प्रचुर-त्व, अम्, n. abundance,
plentifulness, plenty; multitude, numerousness; the
state of being full of, abounding in.
—प्रचुर-
नित्य-धनागम (˚न-आग्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, receiving
many and constant supplies of money.
—प्रचुर-
परिभव, अस्, m. frequent humiliation.
—प्रचुर-
पुरुष, अस्, आ, अम्, abounding with men, populous,
numerous; (अस्), m. a thief; [cf. चौर.]
—प्र-
चुर-रत्न-धनागम (˚न-आग्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
having a large income of gems and money.
—प्र-
चुर-लोम, अस्, आ, अम्, having too much hair.
—प्रचुरी-करण, अम्, n. making abundant or
plentiful; adding to, augmenting, increasing.
—प्र-
चुरी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made abundant or plentiful;
added to, augmented, increased.
—प्रचुरी-भवत्,
अन्, अन्ती, अत्, becoming abundant or plentiful, in-
creasing.
—प्रचुरी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवि-
तुम्, to become abundant or plentiful, to increase.

प्रचूर्ण् प्र-चूर्ण्, cl. 10. P. -चूर्णयति, -यि-
तुम्, to crush, grind to dust, reduce to powder.

प्रचृत् प्र-चृत्, cl. 6. P. -चृतति, -चर्तितुम्,
Ved. to loose, loosen, untie.

प्रचेतृ प्र-चेतृ, ता, m. a charioteer; (a
wrong form for प्र-वेतृ.)

प्रचेल प्र-चेल, अम्, n. (fr. rt. चेल् with
प्र?), yellow sandal-wood.
प्र-चेलक, अस्, m. a horse.

प्रचेलुक प्रचेलुक, अस्, m. a cook; (a wrong
form for पचेलुक, q. v.)

प्रच्छद् 1. प्र-च्छद् (प्र-छद्), cl. 10. P.
(ep. also A.) -छादयति (-ते), -यितुम्, to cover
over, cover, envelop, wrap up; to hide, conceal, dis-
guise, keep secret; to obscure, darken, cloud; to
be in the way, be an obstacle; to cover or clothe
one's self with (with inst.), put on.

2. प्र-च्छद्, त्, f., Ved. a cover, covering; (ac-
cording to Mahī-dhara = अन्न.)

प्र-च्छद, अस्, m. a cover, coverlet, wrapper,
blanket.
—प्रच्छद-पट, अस्, m. ‘enveloping
cloth,’ a cover, wrapper (either of a person or thing,
as a cloak, veil, sheet, curtain, &c.).

प्र-च्छन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, covered, enveloped;
concealed, secreted, hidden; clothed, clad; private,
secret, unavowed, disguised; (अम्), n. a private door
inside a house, private door in general; a lattice, a
loop-hole; (अम्), ind. secretly, covertly.
—प्र-
च्छन्न-चारक, अस्, इका, अम्, acting fraudulently.
—प्रच्छन्न-तस्कर, अस्, m. a secret or unseen
thief.
—प्रच्छन्न-वञ्चक, अस्, m. a secret or
concealed rogue or rascal.
प्रच्छन प्रच्छन. See rt. प्रछ्, col. 3.

प्रच्छन, अम्, आ, n. f. asking, inquiring, a
question, inquiry.
प्र-च्छान, अम्, n. scarifying; making sore.

प्रच्छन्नी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्,
to hide or conceal one's self.
—प्रच्छन्नी-भूय,
ind. being hidden, having become concealed.

प्र-च्छादक, अस्, इका, अम्, concealing, covering
(at the end of a comp., e. g. तमः-प्रच्छादक,
‘enveloping in darkness,’ an epithet of a demon);
(अस्), m. the song of a wife deserted by her husband
(sung with the accompaniment of a lute and con-
taining a covert description of her sorrows).

प्र-च्छादन, अस्, ई, अम्, concealing, hiding;
(अम्), n. covering, concealing, concealment; an upper
or outer garment.
—प्रच्छादन-पट, अस्, m.
‘enveloping-cloth,’ a cover, coverlet, wrapper.

प्र-च्छादित, अस्, आ, अम्, covered, enveloped;
concealed, hidden; clothed.

1. प्र-च्छाद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be covered; to be
hidden or concealed.

2. प्र-च्छाद्य, ind. having covered; having
obscured or darkened; having hidden or concealed.

प्रच्छयित्वा प्र-च्छयित्वा, प्र-च्छान, प्र-
च्छित. See under प्र-च्छो below.

प्र-च्छयित्वा, ind. (?), having made an incision,
having lanced.

प्रच्छाय प्र-च्छाय, अम्, n. a shadowy place,
dense shadow, shade.

प्रच्छिद् 1. प्र-च्छिद् (प्र-छिद्), cl. 7. P. A.
-छिनत्ति, -छिन्त्ते, -छेत्तुम्, to cut off, rend away;
to cut to pieces, cut through, pierce, split, cleave; to
take away, withdraw: Caus. -च्छेदयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to cut off, to order to be lopped off.

2. प्र-च्छिद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. cutting off, cutting to
pieces.

प्र-च्छेदन, अम्, n., Ved. dividing into small
pieces.

प्र-च्छेद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cut to pieces;
[cf. अ-प्˚.]

प्रच्छृद् प्र-च्छृद् (प्र-छृद्), Caus. P.
-च्छर्दयति, -यितुम्, to vomit.

प्र-च्छर्दन, अम्, n. vomiting; emitting,
exhaling; an emetic.
प्र-च्छर्दिका, f. vomiting, sickness.

प्रच्छो प्र-च्छो (प्र-छो), cl. 4. P. -च्छ्यति,
-च्छातुम्, to bleed by making incisions in the skin,
cup, lance, scarify.
प्र-च्छित, अस्, आ, अम्, cut, lanced, scarified.

प्रच्यु प्र-च्यु, cl. 1. A. -च्यवते, -च्योतुम्,
to move, proceed, move away, go away, depart; to
forsake, transgress; to be displaced or ejected, be
deprived of, lose (with abl.); to come forth, flow
out, stream forth; to fall down, drop, stumble; to
set in motion, drive, impel: Caus. -च्यावयति, -यि-
तुम्, to move, shake; to eject, displace, remove,
expel, dispel; to divert (from an opinion &c.); to
cause to fall down or fall out, cause to fall, ruin.

प्र-च्यव, अस्, m. advancement, improvement;
withdrawal; fall, ruin.

प्र-च्यवन, अम्, n. going away, departing,
retreating, withdrawing; being deprived of, loss
(with abl.).

प्र-च्यावन, अम्, n. means of removing or
diminishing, a sedative; causing to desist from or
give up, diverting from (with abl.).
प्र-च्यावुक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. transitory, fragile.

प्र-च्युत, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen from, strayed, de-
viated; ejected, displaced, degraded; banished, ex-
pelled; routed, put to flight, retreated.
—प्रच्युत-
त्व, अम्, n. deviation; the being routed or put to
flight, retreat.

प्र-च्युति, इस्, f. going away, withdrawing, de-
parting; deprivation, loss; the becoming frail or
fragile (Ved.).

प्राचण्ड्य प्राचण्ड्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-चण्ड),
violence, vehemence, passion.
प्राचार्य (प्र-आच्˚), अस्, m. a pupil, scholar (?).
प्राचीन प्राचीन. See p. 654, col. 2.

प्राचीन, अस्, आ, अम्, turned towards the front or
towards the east, belonging to the front or east,
eastern, easterly; former, prior, preceding, ancient,
